meter: USB power meter feeding the board's USB-UART port (display: V, A, mAh, Wh; read by eye)
method: each phase 600 s; energy = meter mAh x volts x 3.6 J; per inference = energy / runs; above idle = (mAh - idle mAh) x volts x 3.6 / runs; the meter counts whole mAh (+-1 mAh per reading); one run per phase
tools: tools/energy_loop.py (firmware: 0xE5 loop on the last input, 'L:count,elapsed_us,class')
notes: the TFLite firmware was rebuilt with the energy loop: 706.3 ms per run in the loop and 706.4 ms median on a 20-image check, vs 717.8 ms in results/tflite/tflite_esp32.json (older build)
SYMBEX loop 47.99 ms vs 48.64 ms per image in the 1,000-image chip run (PR #48)

tflite.label: TFLite Micro INT8 (MLPerf ResNet-8, ESP-NN), flash

meter_raw.note: meter zeroed ~30 s before the loop and read ~30 s after it; 30 s x idle rate (0.4 mAh) subtracted

symbex.label: SYMBEX int8stem_pool2 seed 42, vertical compact engine (PR #48), lut16, flash

meter_raw.note: meter not zeroed between idle and SYMBEX: difference of readings

idle.label: idle: SYMBEX firmware waiting on the serial port
